def prepare_tool_preview(tool_name: str, args: dict | None, *, fallback: str, limit: int) -> ToolPreview:
    """Compact preview plus explicit truncation/URL facts (the uncapped preview is
    rebuilt from the arguments so an upstream display cap cannot drop its link target)."""
    full_text = build_tool_preview(tool_name, args, limit=0) or fallback
    truncated_text = _tail_trunc(full_text, limit)
    url = _preview_url(tool_name, args, full_text)
    truncated = bool(limit and len(full_text) > limit)
    return ToolPreview(text=truncated_text, truncated=truncated, url=url)
